title: Iterated Integrals as Lexical Fingerprints: Path Signature Embeddings for Lexical Similarity
abstract: arXiv:2610.41855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While sentence embeddings are primarily designed for semantic generalization, their latent geometry implicitly encodes surface-level lexical properties, a relationship that remains poorly understood. Shallow pooling methods discard word order, while deep Transformer models obscure these lexical alignments behind computational complexity and uninterpretable spaces. We propose constructing sentence embeddings via the path signature of Word2Vec trajectories, leveraging the iterated integrals of rough path theory to create representations that explicitly capture sequential and lexical structure in a geometrically tractable manner. Through extensive ablations spanning Word2Vec dimensions, signature depths, and PCA compression, we correlate embedding distances against five lexical string metrics: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, word Jaccard, phoneme Levenshtein, and character TF-IDF. translated_title: 迭代积分作为词汇指纹：用于词汇相似性的路径签名嵌入
translated_abstract: 虽然句子嵌入主要为语义泛化而设计，但其潜在几何结构中隐式地编码了表层词汇特性，这一关系至今仍鲜为人知。浅层池化方法会丢弃词序信息，而深度Transformer模型则将这种词汇对应关系隐藏在计算复杂性和不可解释的空间之中。我们提出通过Word2Vec轨迹的路径签名来构建句子嵌入，利用粗糙路径理论中的迭代积分，以几何上易于处理的方式显式捕捉序列与词汇结构。通过对Word2Vec维度、签名深度和PCA压缩进行大量消融实验，我们将嵌入距离与五种词汇字符串度量进行了相关性分析，分别是：Levenshtein编辑距离、Jaro-Winkler距离、词Jaccard相似度、音素Levenshtein距离和字符TF-IDF。我们发现，虽然平均池化几乎完全无法捕捉……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用粗糙路径理论中的迭代积分，通过Word2Vec轨迹的路径签名来构建句子嵌入，以几何可处理的方式显式捕捉词汇与序列结构，并揭示句子嵌入隐式编码表层词汇相似性的规律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constructing sentence embeddings via the path signature of Word2Vec trajectories, leveraging iterated integrals from rough path theory to explicitly capture lexical and sequential structure in a geometrically tractable manner, and reveals how such embeddings encode surface-level lexical similarity.
